description: Header file defining the SourceFile class and related types for representing source files within a build system, including methods for type identification, path resolution, and source set management.

classes.name: SourceFile
classes.description: Represents a source file with methods for type detection, path handling, and comparison.

classes.name: SourceFileTypeSet
classes.description: Manages a set of source file types used in build configurations.

methods.name: GetType
methods.description: Returns the type of the source file based on its extension or path.

methods.name: IsDefType
methods.description: Checks if the source file is a definition type.

methods.name: IsModuleMapType
methods.description: Checks if the source file is a module map.

methods.name: IsObjectType
methods.description: Checks if the source file is an object file.

methods.name: IsSwiftType
methods.description: Checks if the source file is a Swift source.

methods.name: IsSwiftModuleType
methods.description: Checks if the source file is a Swift module.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the filename component after the last slash.

methods.name: GetDir
methods.description: Returns the directory part of the source file.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the source file relative to a given source root.

methods.name: is_source_absolute
methods.description: Checks if the file path is source-absolute (starts with //).

methods.name: is_system_absolute
methods.description: Checks if the file path is system-absolute (starts with /).

methods.name: SourceAbsoluteWithOneSlash
methods.description: Returns the path with a single slash prefix, asserting it is source-absolute.
